name: v11.6.6
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: add CROC_WEB_URL Fixes #1428 by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1431
* fix: shell-quote relay, password and code in the receive command by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1434
* fix: return an error for a bad --throttleUpload and apply large limits exactly by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1435
* build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1433
* fix: include the digit 9 in GenerateRandomPin by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1438
* fix: match --git ignore patterns against relative paths by @b84330808 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1437
* chore: update deps by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1439
* docs: add CrocApp to the community desktop apps by @bakirgdev in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1440
* ci: setup-go with go-version-file by @zdiff in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1442
* fix: preserve received empty file permissions by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1444
* feat: count received bundle bytes in TotalSent by @bakirgdev in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1427
* feat: add Prompt option for library users by @bakirgdev in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1449
* fix: skip NTFS junctions when sending a folder by @b84330808 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1450
* fix: align web tests with send files label by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1451

## New Contributors
* @Kernel-Hunter made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1434
* @b84330808 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1437
* @bakirgdev made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1440
* @pcbeingused333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1444

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.6.5...v11.6.6
